summary: Core AI Holdings, Inc. (formerly Siyata Mobile), a British Columbia foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that director Marc Seelenfreund resigned effective October 27, 2026, expressly without disagreement, and that the Board appointed Haggai Ravid, 65, as an independent director effective October 28, 2026, to fill the vacancy until the next AGM. Ravid is a sitting Sadot Group director and former CEO, with CFO and capital-markets experience. No terms, advisors or consideration were disclosed. Watch for further board turnover and strategic direction under the reconstituted board.
